title: $2099 Complete Bike - SAVA F20 Hawkeye Review

takeaways.text: The XS complete bike (105 mechanical 12-speed, Knight 50 mm carbon wheels, 25 mm IRC tires) weighed 8.7 kg against SAVA's 8.8 kg claim; SAVA gifted the bike and the presenter says he declined payment.
In June 2024 the complete bike listed at about US$2,600 RRP but sold for US$2,199, shipping from a US warehouse.
After about 5,000–6,000 km including months of heavy rain: no creaks, flawless 105 hydraulic braking and internal-cable shifting after one cable-tension tweak, but a little rust on a seatpost bolt.
Four sizes from XS (about 49 cm) to 56 cm, so very tall riders may not fit; stock 100 mm × 40 cm integrated bar, 170 mm cranks and 50/34 with 11–36 gearing.

disclosure: The video includes a discount code and states no commission; the channel's founder also leads Panda Podium.
summary: Model-specific complete-bike review with ride and logistics context; the 2024 price and build cannot establish a current mainland-China variant or RMB observation.
